categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Has the Fuzzing label and adds libFuzzer custom mutator capabilities to src/test/fuzz/fuzz.cpp alongside a PSBT mutator harness.
categories.rationale: Introduces structure-aware fuzzing infrastructure and a custom mutator to penetrate deep PSBT deserialization code paths that byte-level fuzzing cannot reach. The PR description notes that byte-level mutations rarely produce valid keydata or container maps, causing inputs to be rejected early before per-field parsing is tested. In addition to targeting PSBT, it establishes a generic target-specific custom mutator hook in the test framework for future structured targets.
